name: komodo_eggs_hatching
description: The komodo_eggs clutch hatching: same scrape and footprint, five intact leathery eggs plus three torn-open shells with lean komodo_young-style hatchling heads (dark grey-green, yellow-orange speckles, hard narrow amber eye, heavy brow, closed mouth) and clawed forelimbs hooked over the jagged rims; shell fragments. Anchor bottom-centre, ~265x125 (x -132..132, y -125..0).
